subject: Capacity spike: short-term quota bump request
messages:
From: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@pixeldash.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, Procurement <procurement@pixeldash.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity spike: short-term quota bump request

Hi Soojin,

Quick note — we have an unplanned feature toggle going live tonight that will increase our embeddings + chat usage by ~2x for a short window (rough estimate: 48-72 hours, most traffic concentrated in the first 36 hours). Our current monthly commit won't cover the spike and procurement asked us to request a temporary quota increase / alternative to immediate overage charges.

Can Redwood provide a short-term uplift for the coming 72 hours? Ideally we're looking for either:
- A temporary headroom allocation (no up-front charge) with a capped overrun rate, or
- A blended temporary rate / credit that softens the standard overrun pricing for the launch window.

We can provide expected QPS and token-rate telemetry within the hour. Procurement also needs a rough SOW/one-pager and a PO path if we proceed (they asked for billing cadence and invoice timing).

Attached: launch_plan.pdf (high-level traffic profile)

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can decide whether to enable the toggle.

Thanks,
Alyssa Grant
VP Product, Pixeldash
alyssa@pixeldash.ai

---
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@pixeldash.ai>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity spike: short-term quota bump request

Alyssa — thanks for the heads up and the plan. We can support a short-term uplift; below is a pragmatic, low-friction approach we can stand up in the next 2 hours if you confirm numbers.

Proposal (72-hour window):
1) Emergency headroom (first 24 hrs): immediate +25% quota buffer activated with no up-front charge; overrun beyond that buffer billed at a capped emergency rate (our standard overrun rate capped at 0.6x) to avoid sticker shock.
2) Optional extension (next 48 hrs): if you need the uplift extended, we can provide a paid extension at a blended overrun rate equal to 0.8x of standard token overrun price (effectively ~20% discount vs normal overrun) for the remainder of the 72 hr window.
3) Safe-guards: we will enforce a burst window (per-minute QPS ceiling) and automated throttles to avoid runaway costs — we'll provide recommended limits once you share the telemetry.
4) Invoice & PO: we can bill the uplift/overrun on your next monthly invoice. If procurement requires an immediate invoice/PO for accounting, we can produce a one-off invoice and attach it to the PO.

Next steps we need from you:
- Confirm expected peak QPS and tokens/min (reply or paste the CSV)
- Confirm whether procurement needs a signed SOW or a one-pager (we've attached a short provisional terms doc you can hand to them)

Attached: provisional_uplift_terms.pdf (summary sheet)

If you confirm, I'll loop in Jordan for the one-time credit wording and Markus for billing execution. We aim to make this operational without legal redlines — quick thumbs up will let us flip the switch.

—Soojin
Soohin Lee (she/her)
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415-555-0162

---
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@pixeldash.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity spike: short-term quota bump request

Alyssa / Soojin — small internal note and confirmation for procurement: finance has approved a one-time concession that looks like this: 15% credit applied to any billed overrun attributable to the first 48 hours of the uplift (after we step down the emergency headroom). The blended extension Soojin proposed (0.8x standard overrun) is fine for hours 25–72.

Operational bullets:
- I'll prepare a compact SOW (draft-sow.docx) that captures the uplift window, rates, and billing cadence. Procurement can sign that and issue a PO against it.
- If Pixeldash prefers DocuSign, use this link (placeholder): https://docusign.com/sign/abc123 — we'll route to legal if anything in the SOW needs modification.
- For audit/compliance: we will attach token-level usage logs to the invoice and can provide a CSV export for the uplift window.

Alyssa, if that plan works, send the PO to procurement@redwood.ai and I'll kick off billing. If procurement prefers an invoice upfront, indicate that in the PO and we'll generate a one-off invoice immediately.

—Jordan Blake
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai

---
From: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@pixeldash.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@pixeldash.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 17:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity spike: short-term quota bump request

Thanks — this is helpful and acceptable. A few quick confirmations from our side:

- We confirm the initial traffic estimate (attached) and expect peak ~1.9x baseline QPS with most heavy usage within 36 hours.
- Procurement will attach a PO to the SOW. We request monthly invoicing (preferred) but are ok with a one-off invoice if you need it to start the uplift immediately. Please proceed with monthly invoicing unless Redwood requires otherwise.
- We want the token-level usage CSV included with the invoice for our audit team (please include column headers and UTC timestamps).

Attached: purchase_order.pdf

Please go ahead and enable the emergency headroom. I'll notify engineering to flip the toggle once you confirm activation. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Grant
VP Product, Pixeldash
